Every day, WITI’s group chats buzz with fresh links. As part of our Saturday send for paid readers, we round up 11 of the best.
It’s WITI, on the weekend.
Why are these interesting?
The Fox and The Hedgehog [ https://substack.com/redirect/62006b64-9b47-4036-95a4-5a5649dce789?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] (Military Strategy Magazine)
“The fox knows many tricks, but the hedgehog knows one big trick.”
Everything You Learn About Landmen by Watching ‘Landman’ [ https://substack.com/redirect/0aa6125d-17ee-473a-a225-438dfc8bf404?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] (The Ringer)
Basically it involves mineral rights. And a lot of Michelob Ultra.
FDR Drive is Purple by Accident [ https://substack.com/redirect/5467a958-abb2-4093-ae1c-89907158bd3d?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] (Reel NYC)

50 Places in London I would Like to Live [ https://substack.com/redirect/f99443de-93fe-4c07-b5c3-3b4f635da3cb?j=eyJ1IjoiOG81NG4ifQ.6oeetudtJEh-zO1onUJvtadWEdbodFIw0h4xbugrh1o ] (Angus Colwell Food)
